name: Wei Sen
detail: Fudan University economics professor who argued against wealth tax and Piketty's capital tax proposal, stating it violates property rights and triggers capital flight

name: Xu Chenggang
detail: Economist who argued against Piketty's wealth tax, stating wealth concentration stems from institutional and legal privileges rather than market forces

name: Zhu Tian
detail: CEIBS economist who published extensive critiques of global capital and wealth taxation in the 21st Century Capital debate

name: Hao Ruyu
detail: Former member of the NPC Standing Committee who stated that property and wealth taxes on movable wealth are unfeasible in China and unfairly burden transparent assets

name: Zong Qinghou
detail: Billionaire founder of Wahaha and former NPC deputy; died February 2024

name: Jia Kang
detail: Focuses on real estate property tax (房产税) on residential holding rather than general net wealth tax; cautions against early introduction of general capital/wealth taxes

name: Shi Zhengwen
detail: Tax law professor who clarifies legal rules on exit tax, emphasizing China has not introduced exit tax on unrealized gains; focuses on property tax and income tax reform

name: Li Daokui
detail: Tsinghua University economics professor who argued that the Western model of taxing the wealthy is unsuitable for China, warning that wealth and inheritance taxes would trigger capital flight and harm social trust

name: Ma Jun
detail: CASS National Academy of Economic Strategy researcher; analyzed European wealth taxes but explicitly advises caution against adopting wealth taxation in China due to capital flight risks and efficiency costs

name: Gao Peiyong
detail: Former Vice President of CASS; advocates improving direct taxation and local property tax (real estate) alongside inheritance/gift taxes, but does not endorse a general net wealth tax

name: Li Shi
detail: Zhejiang University Institute for Shared Prosperity director and leading inequality researcher; advocates property tax and inheritance/gift taxes for intergenerational transfer, but does not propose general net wealth tax

name: Zhao Guoqing
detail: Zhonghui Tax Group partner and tax law commentator; argued against introducing a separate exit tax, claiming existing income tax clearance rules and tax treaties are sufficient

name: Society for Community Organization
detail: Hong Kong grassroots NGO (SoCO); supports a two-tier progressive salaries/income tax standard rate and profits tax reform on high earners, rather than a tax on capital/wealth stock
